name: PyLM
description: A CodeAct ReAct Agent framework — execution engine, kernel, and HTTP server. PyLM runs LLM-driven AI agents in isolated sandboxes. Each agent reasons and acts by writing and executing Python code (CodeAct paradigm), with support for sub-agents, tool calls, async channels, and task scheduling..
